content: Yihuda Kawa Iyo7akaaza
He biitta asay Iyosyaasa na7aa Iyo7akaaza dooridi iya aawa bessan Yerusalaamen kawothidosona.
Iyo7akaazi kawotiya wode iyaw laythi laatamanne heedza; I Yerusalaamen heedzu ageena kawotis.
Gibxe kawoy Iyo7akaaza kawotethaafe wothis; heedzu mukulunne oyddu xeetu kilo giraame biranne hastamanne oyddu kilo giraame worqa Yihuda asay giirana mela oothis.
Gibxe kawoy, Naakoy, Iyo7akaaza ishaa Eliyaqeeme Yihuda bollanne Yerusalaame bolla kawothidi iya sunthaa Iyo7aqeema yaagidi laammis. Yaatidi Iyo7aqeema ishaa Iyo7akaaza Gibxe efis.
Yihuda Kawa Iyo7aqeema
Iyo7aqeemi kawotiya wode iyaw laythi laatamanne ichasha; I Yerusalaamen tammanne issi laythi kawotis. Ba Godaa Xoossaa sinthan iitabaa oothis.
Babiloone kawoy Nabukadanaxoori iya olidi, Babiloone efanaw naase birata santhalaatan qachis.
Qassi Nabukadanaxoori Xoossa keetha miishiya ekidi Babiloone efidi, ba kawo gadhon wothis.
Iyo7aqeemi oothida harabay, oothida tunabaynne oothida iitaba ubbay, Heko, Isra7eele kawotanne Yihuda kawota taarike maxaafan xaafetis. I hayqin, iya bessan iya na7ay Yo7akini kawotis.
Yihuda Kawa Yo7akina
Yo7akini kawotiya wode iyaw laythi hospuna; I Yerusalaamen heedzu ageenanne tammu gallas kawotis. I Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis.

Laytha laamen, kawoy Nabukadanaxoori ase kiittidi, Yo7akinanne Xoossa keethan de7iya al7o miisheta iyara issife Babiloone ehis. Yaatidi iya aawa ishaa Sedeqiyaasa Yihudanne Yerusalaame bolla kawothis.
Yihuda Kawa Sedeqiyaasa
Sedeqiyaasi kawotiya wode iyaw laythi laatamanne issino; I Yerusalaamen tammanne issi laythi kawotis.
Ba Godaa Xoossaa sinthan iitabaa oothis; qassi Godaa qaala odiya nabiya Ermiyaasa sinthan bana kawushibeenna.
Sedeqiyaasi, ammanetana mela bana Xoossa sunthan caaqisida Nabukadanaxoora bolla makallis. Godaa, Isra7eele Xoossaako simmonna ixis; ba wozana Xoossa bolla minthis.
Qassi, Yihuda asaynne enta kaalethiya kahineti, ammanetona ixidosona. Enti hara kawotethati oothiya ixetida oosota kaallidi, Goday Yerusalaamen geeshshida Xoossa keethaa tunisidosona.
Yerusalaame Kundethaa
Goday, enta mayzata Xoossay ba asaasinne ba keethas qadhetiya gisho, ba nabeta entaw zaari zaari kiittis.
Shin Godaa hanqoy enta bolla wodhana gakanawunne enti kessi ekiyaso dhayana gakanaw Xoossaa kiitanchota qelqisidosona; iya qaala kadhidosona; nabeta bolla miicidosona.

Hessa gisho, Goday Kaldaaweta kawa enta bolla denthin, I enta yalaga addeta Xoossa keethan mashshan wodhis. I yalaga addetas woyko geela7otas woyko cimatas woyko ceegatas qadhetonna wursis. Xoossay enta ubbaa Nabukadanaxoora kushen aathidi immis.
Babiloone kawoy Xoossa keethan de7iya miisheta ubbaa, gitaanne guuthaa, Xoossa keethan de7iya buqura, kawo buquranne iya moorinnata buqura ubbaa ekidi Babiloone efis.
Enti Xoossa keethaa taman xuuggidi, Yerusalaame gimbe dirsaa laallidosona. Kawo gadhuwa taman xuuggidi, yan de7iya al7o miishe ubbaa dhaysidosona.
Mashshafe attidaysata kawoy di77idi Babiloone efis. Farse kawotethay dendana gakanaw enti iyawunne iya naytas aylle gididosona.
Goday nabiya Ermiyaasa baggara odida qaalay poletis. Wursethan biittay laapun tammu laythi asi bayna bessi gididi shempis. Biittay Sambaata shempo demmis.

Farse kawoy Qiroosi kawotida koyro laythan nabiya Ermiyaasa baggara Goday odidaysa polis. Farse kawoy Qiroosi ba kawotethan ubban haysada yaagidi awaajana melanne xaafidi wothana mela Goday iya ayyaana denthethis.

Farse kawoy Qiroosi, “Goday, salo Xoossay ha sa7aa kawotethata ubbaa taw immis. Qassi Yihudan de7iya Yerusalaamen ta iyaw Xoossa keethi keexana mela tana shuumis. Xoossa asi gidida oonika yaa boo. Goday iya Xoossay iyara gido” yaagis.
